items.title: Learn the meaning of Tasbeeh
items.body: SubhanAllah means that Allah is free from every imperfection. Alhamdulillah is praise and gratitude to Allah.

items.title: Quick knowledge check
items.body: Which Surah is known as Umm al-Kitab (the Mother of the Book)?

quiz.explanation: Al-Fatihah is also known as Umm al-Kitab.

items.title: Pause in Ruku and Sujood
items.body: Perform each movement with calmness and composure. Learn the exact recitations and rulings according to your selected school.
